question:
The data given below shows the rainfall (in cm) recorded in a city on 5 different days.

Rainfall: 5, 6, 8, 10, 11

Find the sample variance of the given data.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean = (5 + 6 + 8 + 10 + 11) ÷ 5 = 40 ÷ 5 = 8

Deviations: −3, −2, 0, 2, 3

Squares: 9, 4, 0, 4, 9 → Sum = 26

Sample variance = 26 ÷ (5 − 1) = 26 ÷ 4

**∴ Answer = 6.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data = 5, 6, 8, 10, 11

**Formula used:**

Sample variance = Σ(x − mean)² ÷ (n − 1)

 
• 5 6 8 10 11 Mean = 8 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mean = 40 ÷ 5 = 8

⇒ (x − mean) = −3, −2, 0, 2, 3

⇒ Squares = 9 + 4 + 0 + 4 + 9 = 26

⇒ Sample variance = 26 ÷ (5 − 1) = 26 ÷ 4 = 6.5

**∴ The correct answer is 6.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Population vs Sample Variance

Sample variance uses (n − 1), population variance uses n

Shortcut for Variance

Variance = (Σx² ÷ n) − (mean)²

Standard Deviation

SD = √(variance)

Deviation Method

Take deviations from mean to simplify calculations
